audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers describe Frenzied Maul (W) as a flat 'heals him every trade'. It does not — the heal only fires on the SECOND cast into the same marked target.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.' First W = damage plus mark, no heal. Second W into that mark = bonus damage plus heal. On a flat 5s cooldown that gives Zac a concrete, repeatable disengage cue that the current text never mentions.
audit.corrected: His first Frenzied Maul only marks you; break spacing before the second cast and he heals nothing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentions that Sky Splitter (E) only shields Volibear if he is standing inside his own blast radius.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.' When he throws E at Zac from its 1200 range to poke, he gets the slow but no shield. That distinguishes a poke E (free to walk through, 16s down) from a committed E (he is stepping in, expect the Q follow-up).
audit.corrected: A ranged Sky Splitter gives him no shield — only the one he stands in does. 16s flat either way.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeats 'track Thundering Smash' nine times without ever giving its cooldown, and never gives Stormbringer's.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and its stun only applies when Volibear actually lands an attack on you — it is a movement ramp, not an instant. Stormbringer is 160/135/110s, by far the longest cooldown in this lane. Both numbers convert vague 'respect his cooldowns' filler into a real clock.
audit.corrected: Q is 12s and the stun needs his auto to connect; R is 160s at rank 1 — bait it and the next window is entirely yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names Grievous Wounds despite the matchup being decided by his W heal.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags zac vs volibear as needs-antiheal on Frenzied Maul (W), and also flags onhit-itemization: his W applies on-hit and his passive stacks attack speed, so his damage scales with attack speed and armour alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds by first item; his damage is attack-speed-driven on-hit, so armour alone under-reads the trade.

edits.before: Volibear's Frenzied Maul (W) heals him and his Thundering Smash (Q) stun after running at you makes his all-in reliable — don't Slingshot in when his Q is up, he'll stun-lock and out-sustain your W trade.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul (W) only heals on the SECOND cast into the same mark, and Thundering Smash (Q) only stuns once he lands an attack — so break spacing after his first W and his trade pattern pays him nothing.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) gives him a huge health bar, tower-disabling, and an AOE slam; a 6 all-in favors him hard, so hold your engage and let him waste ult on a fight he can't finish.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) is 160s at rank 1, the longest cooldown in this lane. A straight 6 all-in still favours him, so bait the ult on a fight he cannot finish and own the window after it.

edits.before: With bruiser items his W sustain and Q stun out-duel you 1v1 in the sidelane; farm safe and use your superior wave-clear-to-roam tempo rather than forcing trades into his heal.
edits.after: With bruiser items his double-W heal out-duels you 1v1 in the sidelane — this is where Grievous Wounds stops being optional; use your roam tempo instead of forcing trades into his heal.

edits.before: He stays ahead through 6 — his W heal out-trades you, his Q locks you for follow-up, and Stormbringer's bonus health plus tower-disable make his all-in and dives lethal, so scale and ward for his ganks rather than dueling.
edits.after: He stays ahead through 6, but the sequencing is winnable: his Q stun needs him to reach you and auto, and Sky Splitter (E) only shields him when he stands in his own blast — punish the ranged E, no shield and 16s down.

edits.before: Engage only when Thundering Smash is on cooldown
edits.after: Engage after his Thundering Smash (12s) is spent

edits.before: Levels 4-5 his W sustain out-trades your burst.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 his second-cast W heal out-trades you.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. E-knock around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash: 12s at rank 1, and the stun only lands on his attack — hold E until he commits. - Frenzied Maul: 5s, heals on the second cast only. - Stormbringer: 160s — bait it, own the window.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: his Q is 12s and Sky Splitter 16s, and neither shields him at range. Bank small leads; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1 — the biggest cooldown in the lane. If he spends it on a fight he cannot close, the window is yours.

notes: The packet suspectName ('Let's Bounce' in spikes[3]) is a FALSE POSITIVE — the file already writes "Let's Bounce!" correctly and the detector strips the trailing '!'. IMPORTANT — I did NOT act on the _missing-interactions entry 'Your Elastic Slingshot (E) shuts off Volibear's Stormbringer (R)'. That rule fires off a 'grounding' flag on Zac's E in the kit file, and that flag looks like a derivation artifact: Riot's E text reads 'Zac attaches his arms to the ground', and Zac has no grounding effect in his actual kit. The same bad flag will be generating false grounding claims for every Zac matchup across the whole dataset — worth checking tools/build-kit-library.js. Not verified and left alone: whether Zac's E landing knock-up can interrupt the cast of Stormbringer.
